step1_analysis.description: A current-starved inverter followed by a standard CMOS inverter. The control voltage VC sets the current limit for both the pull-up and pull-down networks of the first stage via a current mirror, allowing for a tunable propagation delay. This is likely used in the clocking or timing generation for the DAC/mixer.

paper_reference.title: A 10-Bit Wide-Band CMOS Direct Digital RF Amplitude Modulator

delay_rise.description: Propagation delay from IN rising edge to OUT rising edge

sky130_expected.calculation: I_bias ≈ 0.5 * un * Cox * (W/L) * (VC - Vth)^2 ≈ 0.5 * 270u * 10 * (0.9 - 0.42)^2 ≈ 311uA. C_node5 ≈ 50fF. Delay ≈ (C * VDD/2) / I_bias + inv_delay ≈ (50fF * 0.9V) / 311uA + 50ps ≈ 195ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on charging/discharging the internal node capacitance with the bias current set by VC=0.9V.

delay_fall.description: Propagation delay from IN falling edge to OUT falling edge

sky130_expected.calculation: Similar to delay_rise due to symmetric current mirroring (XM8 pull-up current equals XM2 pull-down current).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Symmetric design ensures similar rise and fall delays.

power.description: Average power consumption of the delay cell during switching

sky130_expected.calculation: P_dyn = C_tot * VDD^2 * f. For C_tot=100fF, f=100MHz, P_dyn = 100fF * 1.8^2 * 100e6 = 32uW. Adding short-circuit and static power yields ~50-100uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Estimated dynamic power for a single delay cell at 100MHz.

trip_point.description: DC input voltage where OUT crosses VDD/2

sky130_expected.calculation: First stage has perfectly matched pull-up/pull-down currents. Second stage has equal W/L for PMOS/NMOS, so trip point is slightly below VDD/2 due to weaker PMOS.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on standard CMOS inverter characteristics with equal sizing.

system_power_consumption.description: Total power consumption of the entire RF modulator

sky130_expected.calculation: System level metric, depends on the full DAC and mixer implementation.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down slightly for 1.8V SKY130 process compared to 3.3V 0.35um.

system_gain.description: Conversion gain of the RF modulator

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the Gilbert cell mixer and DAC current scaling.

system_output_power.description: Output power of the modulated RF signal

sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the 1.8V supply in SKY130 compared to 3.3V in the paper.
Depends on DAC resolution (10-bit) and linearity.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure propagation delay, rise/fall times, average power, and DC trip point of the current-starved delay cell.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Current-Starved Delay Cell Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

XM1 N5 IN N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 VC GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 VC GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N3 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N5 IN N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 OUT N5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 OUT N5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N1 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVC VC 0 0.9
VIN IN 0 PULSE(0 1.8 2n 0.1n 0.1n 5n 10n)

.control
tran 10p 20n
meas tran delay_rise trig v(IN) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(OUT) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran delay_fall trig v(IN) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(OUT) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran trise trig v(OUT) val=0.36 rise=1 targ v(OUT) val=1.44 rise=1
meas tran tfall trig v(OUT) val=1.44 fall=1 targ v(OUT) val=0.36 fall=1
let pwr = -i(VVDD)*1.8
meas tran avg_power avg pwr

dc VIN 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc trip_point when v(OUT)=0.9 rise=1
quit
.endc
